description: This file defines an internal implementation of an inlined vector container within the Abseil C++ library, including templates for storage management, iterators, and policies for efficient memory operations.

classes.name: Storage
classes.description: A template class managing inline and heap storage for a vector, with methods for initialization, resizing, insertion, erasure, and memory management policies.

classes.name: IteratorValueAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class to construct or assign values from an iterator.

classes.name: CopyValueAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class to copy values from a pointer.

classes.name: AllocationTransaction
classes.description: Helper class managing temporary memory allocation and deallocation during vector operations.

classes.name: ConstructionTransaction
classes.description: Helper class managing temporary construction of elements during vector resize or insert operations.

methods.name: DestroyContents
methods.description: Destroys all elements and deallocates storage if necessary.

methods.name: InitFrom
methods.description: Initializes storage from another storage instance.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes storage with a set of values and size.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Assigns new values to storage, resizing as needed.

methods.name: Resize
methods.description: Resizes storage, constructing or destroying elements as needed.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts elements at a specified position.

methods.name: EmplaceBack
methods.description: Constructs and adds a new element at the end.

methods.name: EmplaceBackSlow
methods.description: Slow path for EmplaceBack when reallocation is needed.

methods.name: ShrinkToFit
methods.description: Reduces capacity to fit current size.

methods.name: Swap
methods.description: Swaps contents with another storage instance.
